description: Cross-SDK contract cases. Every runner (sdk/python/tests/contract, sdk/typescript/tests/contract.test.ts, sdk/go/mockagents/contract_test.go) executes each case through its SDK's public client + assertion API against one real server and checks each assertion's verdict against `expect`. See sdk/contract/README.md for the field reference.

assertion_kinds.response_contains: args {text}. FINAL turn content contains text. py to_have_response_containing / ts toHaveResponseContaining / go ToHaveContentContaining.
assertion_kinds.tool_call: args {name, arguments?}. Some tool call in ANY turn has this name and (partial match) every given argument present with an equal value; an explicit null never matches an absent key. py to_have_tool_call / ts toHaveToolCall / go ToHaveToolCall.
assertion_kinds.tool_call_count: args {count, name?}. Total tool calls across ALL turns (or calls to `name`). py to_have_tool_call_count / ts toHaveToolCallCount / go ToHaveToolCallCount, ToHaveToolCallCountByName.
assertion_kinds.tool_call_sequence: args {names}. Exact ordered tool-call names across ALL turns (full equality, not a subsequence). py to_have_tool_call_sequence / ts toHaveToolCallSequence / go ToHaveToolCallSequence.
assertion_kinds.finish_reason: args {reason}. FINAL turn finish/stop reason. py to_have_finish_reason / ts toHaveFinishReason / go ToHaveFinishReason.
assertion_kinds.status_code: args {code}. FINAL turn HTTP status. py to_have_status / ts toHaveStatusCode / go ToHaveStatusCode. Non-streaming cases only.
assertion_kinds.stream_text_matches_nonstream: args {}. Streaming cases only: the final turn's text, concatenated from the SDK's iter_stream/iterStream/IterStream chunks, equals the content the same steps produce without streaming. A runner-level check built on each SDK's public stream iterator (no SDK has a stream-vs-batch matcher).

cases.name: final-turn-vs-any-turn-openai
cases.description: Two-turn recovery: turn 1 mentions 'error', the final turn does not. Outcome assertions read the FINAL turn, so 'contains error' must FAIL in every SDK. (The any-turn matcher exists only in Python - to_have_any_response_containing - so it is not part of the shared contract.)

cases.name: tool-call-arguments-openai
cases.description: Integer argument limit: 5 must match in every SDK (Go compares JSON-normalised values); a string '5' must not. An explicit null argument matches an expected null; a MISSING key never matches an expected null.

cases.name: tool-trajectory-across-turns-openai
cases.description: Turn 1 calls search_docs, turn 2 calls summarize. Count and sequence read the aggregate of ALL turns; the sequence is exact (order and length).

cases.name: tool-trajectory-across-turns-anthropic
cases.description: Same cross-turn trajectory over the Anthropic Messages protocol.

cases.name: server-error-raises-openai
cases.description: The agent always answers 503. The SDK must RAISE, so even a vacuous negative assertion (zero tool calls) cannot false-pass on an error body. Verdict 'error' = executing the case raised.

cases.name: server-error-raises-anthropic
cases.description: 503 over the Anthropic Messages protocol must raise too.

cases.name: server-error-raises-stream-openai
cases.description: A 503 on a streaming request must raise, not read the error body as an empty stream.

cases.name: server-error-raises-stream-anthropic
cases.description: A 503 on an Anthropic streaming request must raise.

cases.name: mt-tenant-key-chat-openai
cases.description: Multi-tenant: the tenant key reaches the tenant-owned agent that shadows the global one (same model).

cases.name: mt-tenant-key-stream-openai
cases.description: Multi-tenant: the tenant key is sent on streams too (review K-01).

cases.name: mt-tenant-key-chat-anthropic
cases.description: Multi-tenant over Anthropic Messages: the key goes out as Authorization and X-Api-Key.

cases.name: mt-tenant-key-stream-anthropic
cases.description: Multi-tenant over Anthropic Messages streaming.

cases.name: mt-no-key-global-fallback-openai
cases.description: Multi-tenant: an anonymous caller reaches the GLOBAL agent, never the tenant's.

cases.name: mt-no-key-global-fallback-stream-anthropic
cases.description: Multi-tenant: anonymous Anthropic stream (placeholder X-Api-Key) reaches the global agent.

cases.name: mt-wrong-key-openai
cases.description: Multi-tenant, server-defined behaviour: the LLM endpoints are auth-exempt (clients send their own provider keys), so a presented-but-unregistered key is NOT a 401 - the request proceeds anonymously and reaches the global agent (tenancy.AuthMiddleware skip routes resolve credentials best-effort).

cases.name: mt-wrong-key-stream-anthropic
cases.description: Multi-tenant: an unregistered key on an Anthropic stream also falls back to the global agent.
